$comment: Every tuned constant in the engine, with the benchmark artifact that justifies it.
A constant not in this ledger may not steer behavior.
It is empty because nothing is tuned yet. C0 built the oracle and the harness; there is no
engine, no cache, no batch size, no threshold, and no benchmark. The first entries arrive
when the first constant does — RocksDB block cache and bloom filters in C8, consolidate()
tuning in C10 — and each one arrives with its receipt or not at all.
"name":       "the constant, as it appears in code",
"measured_on": "the machine and configuration the artifact was produced on",
